name: code-index
description: Standalone Bun+TS code index plugin, MCP server, and lifecycle hooks.

interface.shortDescription: Build and query a code index for any project.
interface.longDescription: A standalone Bun+TS plugin that builds and queries repository code indexes, exposes them through MCP, and refreshes the index on Codex session lifecycle events.
defaultPrompt: Build or refresh the code index for this workspace.
Search symbols and modules from the generated index.
Use MCP tools to inspect index artifacts.
